blocks.instruction: Leia o texto e escolha a alternativa correta. Algumas perguntas pedem inferência — a resposta não está escrita com todas as letras.
blocks.passage:
Logistics has two directions. Inbound is what comes into the company. It is raw materials from suppliers, parts for the factory, and packaging from a printer.

Outbound is what goes out to customers. It is finished products, parcels, and pallets ready to sell. Both directions matter. A factory with no inbound stops producing. A factory with no outbound cannot deliver.

Companies usually have different teams for each side, because the work is different. Inbound deals with suppliers. Outbound deals with customers. In and out — the two halves of any logistics operation.

items.q: What is inbound?
items.why: "Inbound is what comes into the company."

items.q: What does outbound deal with?
items.why: "Outbound deals with customers."

items.q: Why do companies use different teams for each side?
options: Because the trucks are the same
items.why: "Companies usually have different teams for each side, because the work is different."

items.q: The text suggests that a company needs…
items.why: Inferência: sem inbound a fábrica para; sem outbound não entrega. Os dois lados são necessários.

items.q: The author would most likely DISAGREE with this idea:
options: One team can do all the work the same way.
Inbound and outbound are both important.
items.why: Inferência: o texto diz que o trabalho é diferente e que as equipes costumam ser separadas.

blocks.instruction: Ouça Oliver mostrando as duas portas do cais. Responda sem ler a transcrição — ela só aparece depois de corrigir.

audio.text:
Welcome to the dock. Let me show you the two doors. This is the most important thing to learn on your first day.

This door on the left is for inbound trucks. Inbound means everything that comes in. Trucks from our suppliers arrive here. They bring raw materials, parts, and packaging. We check every box. Then we move it into the warehouse. This side deals with suppliers.

Now look at the door on the right. This one is for outbound trucks. Outbound means everything that goes out. We load finished products here. We put parcels and pallets on the trucks. Then the trucks drive to our customers. This side deals with customers.

So, two doors, two directions. In on the left, out on the right. Remember this and you will not get lost. If you ever see a truck at the wrong door, come and tell me. In and out must always stay separate here.
audio.label: Ouça quantas vezes precisar. A transcrição aparece depois de corrigir.

items.q: What is the door on the left for?
items.why: "This door on the left is for inbound trucks."

items.q: What do the inbound trucks bring?
items.why: "They bring raw materials, parts, and packaging."

items.q: Where do the outbound trucks go?
items.why: "Then the trucks drive to our customers."

items.q: Why does Oliver say "you will not get lost"?
options: Because the two doors are easy to remember
Because the dock is very small
Because there is a map on the wall
items.why: Inferência: com a regra simples (in à esquerda, out à direita) o novato não se confunde.

items.q: What does Oliver want the new coordinator to do if a truck is at the wrong door?
items.why: Inferência: ele diz "come and tell me" — o novato deve avisá-lo, não resolver sozinho.

blocks.instruction: O vocabulário da lição aparece aqui em frases novas. Escolha o sentido ou a palavra que cabe no contexto.

items.q: "The supplier sends us parts every week." A supplier is…
options: a company that gives us materials
a customer who buys from us
items.why: Supplier = fornecedor: quem fornece materiais para a empresa.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "We put the boxes on a wooden ___ before we load the truck."
items.why: Pallet = palete, a base de madeira onde as caixas ficam.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "Your ___ will arrive at your house tomorrow."
items.why: Parcel = encomenda, o pacote que chega ao cliente.

items.q: "The packaging keeps the product safe." Packaging is…
options: the box or material around a product
items.why: Packaging = embalagem: o material que protege o produto.

items.q: Choose the correct word: "A factory with no inbound cannot ___ anything."
items.why: To produce = produzir. Sem inbound, faltam materiais e a fábrica para de produzir.

blocks.instruction: Expressões simples que aparecem no cais e na logística. Escolha o sentido no contexto.

items.q: "We load up the truck in the morning." To load up means to…
items.why: Load up = carregar, colocar as coisas dentro do caminhão.

items.q: "The parts will come in on Monday." To come in means to…
items.why: Come in = chegar, entrar. É o sentido de inbound.

items.q: "The finished products go out to customers." To go out means to…
items.why: Go out = sair. É o sentido de outbound.

items.q: "We check in every box that arrives." To check in means to…
items.why: Check in = registrar a chegada de algo, dar entrada.

items.q: "The truck is ready to set off." To set off means to…
items.why: Set off = partir, começar a viagem.
